description.value: Cedar Grove sits along the Little Qualicum River in Qualicum Beach with a clear summer swimming hole and forested sites, within walking distance of sandy ocean beaches, seafood restaurants, and a Saturday farmers market. Open year-round, it's a well-maintained private campground with 108 sites—ideal for families and cyclists exploring central Vancouver Island.

address.value: 246 Riverbend Road, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2N2
